title: A bee's trips to the flowers
checked: Every reachable state checked (6 states, 37 with their data, 57 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 6 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
The hive holds 5 combs of honey. No bee brings a sixth.
rules.path: Take away the hive not full guard and it breaks in 36 steps: fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload.

rules.rule: No trip from a full hive
rules.says: When every comb is full, the bee stays home for the winter.
rules.path: Take away the hive not full guard and it breaks in 31 steps: fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out, fly on, sip nectar, fly on, fly on, unload, fly out.

rules.rule: Home by the pond only with nectar
rules.says: The bee leaves the clover for the pond only with a full basket.
rules.path: Take away the nectar in the basket guard and it breaks in 3 steps: fly out, fly on, fly on.
